1. Adding the correct Note Template to cover all the critical points. An updated note summary must be added if there is a long thread.

Note Template must cover the following:

Serial Number (if Studio) | Core 1.0/2.0 (If Move)
The detailed reported issue.
The troubleshooting steps we did to resolve the issue, and if there aren't, then add a reference of why we didn't follow a specific path to troubleshoot.
FULL ADDRESS of the customer if the issue is unresolved by troubleshooting.
Video call recording link.
Resolution/Next steps
Slack link [IF APPLICABLE]
Replacement tracking number/ETA if submitted through MX Shipping [IF APPLICABLE]
Replacement Order Number if submitted through Shopify [IF APPLICABLE]
Jira ticket link [IF APPLICABLE]

2. If we send a replacement item, the address must be updated on the primary customer's profile in Shopify directly in case the customer provided a different address.

3. Choosing the correct/relevant VOC category.
